questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if the Bayview Hotel and the Woy Woy Hotel are close competitors and there are not many alternatives or if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Laundy, the Bayview Hotel and/or Woy Woy Hotel.

questions.section: Questions for suppliers of on-premises hospitality services (e.g. pub, community club, RSL) in Woy Woy or the surrounding area
questions.text: Identify the characteristics of your venue’s offering that are designed to attract customers and/or increase sales at your premises. For example, do you focus on having the widest range of food and beverage offerings, lowest prices, loyalty programs, convenient location, community events, extended opening hours, entertainment, gaming, parking etc?

questions.section: Questions for suppliers of on-premises hospitality services (e.g. pub, community club, RSL) in Woy Woy or the surrounding area
questions.text: Identify alternative suppliers of on-premises hospitality services that you compete against in Woy Woy and the surrounding area. Provide a brief description of the level of competition they provide including with reference to whether their venue’s offering is similar or different to yours.

questions.section: Questions for suppliers of on-premises hospitality services (e.g. pub, community club, RSL) in Woy Woy or the surrounding area
questions.text: Describe the process, indicative costs and approximate timeframes that would be involved in opening an on-premises hospitality service in Woy Woy or the surrounding area.

questions.section: Questions for suppliers of on-premises hospitality services (e.g. pub, community club, RSL) in Woy Woy or the surrounding area
questions.text: Describe what customers you regularly serve. Examples could include members, visitors to Woy Woy and the surrounding area, neighbourhood regulars, age demographics and how the customer mix might vary between weekdays and weekends.

questions.section: Questions for suppliers of on-premises hospitality services (e.g. pub, community club, RSL) in Woy Woy or the surrounding area
questions.text: Having regard to existing liquor licensing regulations, identify whether you already offer packaged takeaway liquor or have scope to expand your existing offering into selling packaged takeaway liquor via either your existing premises, or off-site/detached premises. In your response, set out any opportunities or constraints that you consider relevant to expanding into selling packaged takeaway liquor.

questions.section: Questions for consumers of on-premises hospitality services and/or packaged takeaway liquor in Woy Woy and the surrounding area
questions.text: Describe the factors that you consider most important, or you value the most, when choosing which pub/premises to attend or use for on-premises hospitality services. For example: the location, prices, loyalty programs, service quality, atmosphere, entertainment and gaming facilities, community events, opening hours etc.

questions.section: Questions for consumers of on-premises hospitality services and/or packaged takeaway liquor in Woy Woy and the surrounding area
questions.text: Identify the closest alternatives to Bayview Hotel and Woy Woy Hotel and outline the reasons. For example, the factors you consider most important could include the range of products (eg tap and bottle beers), product prices, loyalty programs and promotions, service quality, whether the bottle shop is located near a pub, opening hours, brand of bottle shop etc.
